compiled_state.description:
## Summary

`os.path.dirname(tracker)` is used as a REPO/CONFIG root at **9 further sites** beyond the two
fixed under `chuffy-arbored-goldfish`. That inference is correct only when the tracker sits
inside the checkout. `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR` relocating the store is a supported feature
(`_config_sources.tracker_dir_override`) and the deployed MCP server uses it — store at
`/var/gerrit/site/mcp-tickets`, repo at `/app` — so every one of these resolves a directory with
no `rebar.toml`.

## Sites (all verified present, `src/rebar`)

- `_cli/_execute.py:86` — `fn(rest, tracker, os.path.dirname(tracker))`. The CLI dispatcher
  passes this as `repo_root` to EVERY command, so the whole CLI inherits the assumption.
- `_commands/transition.py:275` — `repo_root_str = os.path.dirname(tracker)`, then `:348`
  feeds it to `gates.plan_review_precheck` — the OTHER start-work gate path, the sibling of
  the claim site already fixed.
- `_commands/transition.py:690` — `_unarchive(...)`
- `_commands/compact_trigger.py:107` — `compose_config(os.path.dirname(tracker)).compact`
- `_commands/compact_trigger.py:213`, `:246`
- `_commands/delete.py:390` — `scratch.cleanup_for_ticket(...)`
- `_engine_support/validate.py:121` — `repo_root=os.path.dirname(tracker)`
- `_lib_gates.py:53` — `gates._clarity_threshold(os.path.dirname(tracker), None)`

## Why this matters more than a wrong default

Proven under `chuffy-arbored-goldfish`: for a GATE FLAG, an empty config reads as OFF. The
regression test there shows the plan-review start-work gate silently STOPS APPLYING on a
relocated store — `DID NOT RAISE` where it must block. `transition.py:275/:348` is the same
gate reached through `transition open -> in_progress`, so the claim-side fix alone leaves that
door open.

## Scope note

`chuffy-arbored-goldfish` deliberately fixed only the CLAIM path (`claim.py:116`, `:201`) plus
the `gates.py` signatures, keeping that change reviewable and inside its ticket's scope. This
ticket carries the rest. Split recorded with the operator's approval; the work is tracked here
rather than dropped.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `transition open -> in_progress` applies the plan-review gate on a relocated store.
      (The claim-side equivalent is already pinned by
      `test_plan_review_gate_still_applies_when_the_tracker_lives_outside_the_repo`.)
- [ ] The CLI dispatcher resolves a repo root that does not assume a co-located tracker.
- [ ] Each remaining site above resolves config from the repo root, or documents why the
      tracker's parent is correct for it.
- [ ] A guard fails if a new `os.path.dirname(tracker)`-as-config-root site is introduced.
compiled_state.title: dirname(tracker) is used as a repo/config root at 9 more sites, disabling gates on a relocated store
